lines.text: Accidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions.
All accidents, injuries, near misses, damage, and dangerous occurrences must be reported to your supervisor as soon as possible.
This includes incidents where nobody was injured, but somebody could have been.
Near-miss reporting is important, because it gives us an opportunity to put things right before someone gets hurt.
You will not be criticised for raising a genuine safety concern.
If something is unsafe, stop the activity, make the area safe where you can do so without putting yourself at risk, and report it.
See it. Make it safe. Report it.
